comparison.objective: Feed two meat cubes through a grinder throat using its pusher while keeping grippers out; unlike tuning and mechanically locking a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Pick/place food and align and push a plunger with sufficient axial force. It lacks tool-in-screw insertion, collar rotation, counterholding, relocking, and iterative adjustment from dynamic response.
comparison.success_condition: Both cubes must pass the simulated throat doors, grippers withdraw at least 6 cm, and fingertips never enter the throat. The record supplies thresholds, although the auger and meat are deliberately simplified rigid proxies.
comparison.reason: Axial pushing and keep-out safety do not test the candidate’s fine adjustment, torque-controlled retention, or repeated energy-absorption commissioning.
